items.titleTR: Venezuela's Dancing Devils revive centuries-old Corpus Christi rite

slots.packetSpot: In Germany, the Bavarian lake procession on Staffelsee and Venezuela's Dancing Devils both celebrate Corpus Christi with unique, centuries-old traditions. These events highlight the cultural diversity and historical depth of Corpus Christi celebrations globally.
slots.packetTitle: Centuries-Old Corpus Christi Traditions in Germany and Venezuela
